node.title: ES route: adapt the algebraic regularity lemma (Tao) as the off-the-shelf enumerator
node.statement: Formulate alignment as a definable relation of bounded description complexity and apply an F_q algebraic-regularity/ES-type theorem: structure-vs-pseudorandomness with power savings, exceptional sets ALGEBRAIC and classifiable. Named obstacle: bounded complexity vs our degrees growing with t — the same dimension-free obstacle in regularity-lemma clothing.
